notes.title: DYING: Reborn Patch Update (Minor Fixes)
notes.notes:
Dear all, we've updated the game on 20th Jan with some of the feedback we got from the community. Sorry for the delay of the notes! Please see below for the specific changes and thanks so much for all the feedback, keep it comin'! 

1. Updated the first chapter's tutorial on item combination. 

2. Optimized the picking up system + chapter 5 sound effects of breathing.

3. Optimized graphic effects of in-game icons.

4. Fixed the Disc bug in chapter two. Able to be picked up again with a mouse click after already equipped.  

5. Fixed the radio bug in chapter two. Only able to receive the radio password after solving correlated puzzles.

6. Fixed the bug in chapter six where players can be hit out of the wall after drawing the locker. 

7. Fixed the bug in secret chapter where players can pass through doors that should be blocked. 

8. Fixed the bug that players can see numbers on the back of some password plates after opening them.

notes.title: Dying Reborn - A spine-chilling Horror
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31373766/cc3f204eab8797e13bfa36d5033b46d9ed5519e5.jpg[/img]

Last Harbor, a family retreat by the sea, with a beautiful scenery and exquisit food for the special once-in-a-lifetime experience. Sounds nice? Not so in this hotel! Though being unique, Matthew’s experience after waking up in this eerie hotel is anything but pleasant. Follow him and his story in Dying: Reborn to find out the truth about his sister’s abduction. 

The game is a dark, horror puzzler that delivers a unique first-person room escape experience. Released on popular consoles, the game is scheduled for release on [b]January 11 here on Steam.[/b] 

[h1]New Features include:[/h1]

[b]1. Additional content[/b]
•	New collectables
•	New hidden ending
•	More achievements

[b]2. A new control scheme[/b] 
•	Fully customizable keyboard & mouse controls

[b]3. Skip animation feature[/b]

[b]4. More options and settings, including graphic and sound settings[/b]

[b]5. Language Support[/b]
•	Support for various languages including: Simplified Chinese/Traditional Chinese and Japanese.
•	Language voice over: Japanese

[b]6.  Cloud storage service for instant game progress saving.[/b]
 
[b]7.  Optimized system stability for enhanced game experience.[/b]
 
Discover the truth, investigate the case and solve the mysteries in Dying: Reborn.
